environment.description: Lambda function deployed with Function URL configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The function URL endpoint requires valid AWS Signature Version 4 (SigV4) signed requests. An internal API Gateway (REST, private) fronts the Lambda invocation for authorized internal services using IAM roles with sts:AssumeRole constrained by aws:SourceVpc condition. The Lambda resource policy specifies lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl with aws:PrincipalOrgID condition limiting to the organization. Additionally, the Function URL has invoke mode RESPONSE_STREAM with a resource-based policy that denies lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl unless aws:PrincipalArn matches the specific internal service role ARN (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/InternalAccountService). Browser-originated requests cannot produce valid SigV4 signatures for cross-origin requests, as the signing credentials are never exposed to client-side code.
